content.value_statement: Image review often needs structured visual reasoning, not only a short caption. This skill guides GLM-4V prompts for descriptions, visual questions, OCR, and detail extraction.
actual_capabilities: Describes visible objects, scenes, actions, and spatial relationships in an image.
Answers targeted questions about people, objects, counts, and visible activity.
Extracts readable text from images when the text is clear enough for OCR.
Analyzes colors, shapes, layout, atmosphere, and technical visual details.
Shows the expected GLM-4V tool parameters for image URL and prompt input.
limitations: Requires an accessible image URL for the model call.
Does not support real-time video streams or 3D model analysis.
Cannot reliably analyze unclear, low-resolution, or blocked images.
Sensitive or inappropriate images may be rejected by model safety rules.

use_cases.title: Product Image Review
use_cases.description: Summarize product photos, identify visible attributes, and flag missing details for catalog preparation.

use_cases.title: Document Screenshot Reading
use_cases.description: Extract visible text and layout details from screenshots for faster triage and note taking.

use_cases.title: Research Image Inspection
use_cases.description: Ask focused visual questions about diagrams, scenes, or reference images during research workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image Description
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a general caption.
prompt_templates.prompt: Describe this image in simple terms. Include the main subject, setting, visible objects, and overall mood.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Visual Question
prompt_templates.scenario: Ask one direct question about a visible detail.
prompt_templates.prompt: Answer this question using only visible evidence from the image: [question]. State when the image is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: OCR and Layout Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Extract text and summarize visual structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read any visible text in the image. Then describe the layout, headings, tables, labels, and important visual hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Inspection Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the image step by step. Cover objects, relationships, text, colors, technical details, uncertainty, and follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: A product photo showing a backpack on a white background.
output_examples.output: The image shows a black backpack with two shoulder straps, a front zipper pocket, and a plain studio background.

output_examples.input: A screenshot of a dashboard with charts and labels.
output: Visible text includes the dashboard title, metric labels, and chart legends.
The layout uses a top summary row and multiple chart panels below it.
Some small labels may need a higher-resolution image for reliable reading.

output_examples.input: A street scene with people and vehicles.
output_examples.output: The scene appears to show pedestrians near parked cars. The exact number of people is uncertain because some figures are partially hidden.

best_practices: Use a direct image URL that the model can access without authentication.
Ask specific questions when accuracy matters for counts, text, or small details.
Request uncertainty notes for ambiguous areas or low-quality images.
anti_patterns: Do not submit private or sensitive images through public URLs.
Do not rely on the model for identity, medical, legal, or safety-critical conclusions.
Do not use vague prompts when the task requires exact fields or focused evidence.

faq.question: What image formats can this skill work with?
faq.answer: The source notes support for common formats such as JPEG, PNG, and WebP.

faq.question: Does it require a public image URL?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill expects an image URL that the GLM-4V tool can access.

faq.question: Can it extract text from images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes OCR-style text recognition when the text is visible and clear.

faq.question: Can it analyze videos?
faq.answer: No. The source states that real-time video streams are not supported.

faq.question: Which model does the skill recommend?
faq.answer: The skill instructs users to use the glm-4v-flash model.

faq.question: Is the output always exact?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on image quality, prompt clarity, model limits, and visible evidence.
